aww14.source: Atkinson, Worden & Wald (2014), BSSA 104(6):3084, doi:10.1785/0120140178. Coefficients as implemented in GeoscienceAustralia ga-earthquake-hazard atkinson_2014_ipe.py and treviallen mmi_tools.py (the paper itself was not read).
aww14.form: MMI = c1 + c2*M + c3*log10(R) + c4*R + c5*B + c6*M*log10(R); R = sqrt(Rhyp^2 + h^2); B = max(0, log10(R/50))
aww14.sigma_note: UNVERIFIED: the two implementations disagree (0.5 and 0.15)

worden2012.source: Worden et al. (2012), BSSA 102(1); coefficients from USGS ShakeMap shakelib/gmice/wgrw12.py
